## Features
- Animated Christmas Scenes
- Christmas sounds
- Multicoloured LEDs
- Classic Christmas decoration:  Bring festive cheer to a Christmas display with an animated musical scene, that features colourful LED lighting and plays an array of Christmas tunes as Santa's reindeer driven sleigh passes under a village toy shop
- Versatile decoration: Placed at the heart of a Christmas display, on a windowsill or mantelpiece, or even at the centre of your Christmas table, this scene will bring festive joy to all ages, capturing the magic of the season in a delightful way
- Musical medley: The tunes played are Jingle Bells, We Wish You a Merry Christmas, Silent Night, Deck the Halls, Joy to the World, The First Noel and Hark the Herald Angels Sing

## Information
The magic of Christmas is captured in this lovely resin decoration, which features Santa on his sleigh about to soar into the night sky and deliver presents to all of the children who made it onto the 'Nice' list. The sleigh and the reins harnessing Santa's 8 trusty reindeer are lit by warm LED lights (3 x AAA batteries required, not included), creating a pulsing yet festive glow & the beautifully detailed painted finish means this will be a decoration for your Christmas display for years to come. Santa's sleigh and reindeer is the perfect size for windowsills or mantelpieces, but will look beautiful wherever it is placed
Musicians play in front of the village toy shop, whilst Santa and his reindeer-driven sleigh go through a tunnel under the village. The buildings are lit with LEDs and the train rotates around creating a festive mood that will keep children and adults captivated alike.
